visuals.display: Chrome Page.captureScreenshot fromSurface at the fixed 395x700 CSS clip/native DPR, after two RAFs of the paused same frame; controls hidden by test-only CSS. No offline resampling.
visuals.selection: Most frequent actual backing-store size in the final 10 seconds of each cloud phase; fraction and all changes retained in timing summary. Not a claim of permanent stability.
visuals.motion: 32 deterministic frames at 10/24 simulated seconds per frame, starting t=3435.65 at the beginning of the final 10-second cloud selection window (1.33 seconds of 24 fps/10x playback). This replays an observed size on matching scenes; it does not prove that the frozen scene establishes that size. Seek step=any avoids UI quantization; matching poses are asserted across profiles/sizes. Readbacks are outside cadence timing.
